     1	const trimmed = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '');

     3	export const normalizeGuestName = (name) => trimmed(name).replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

    11	export const prepareGuest = (request) => {
    12	    const hostId = normalizeMemberId(request.memberId);
    13	    if (!hostId) throw new Error('host member is required');
    14	    const name = normalizeGuestName(request.name);
    15	    if (!name) throw new Error('guest name is required');
    16	    const email = trimmed(request.email).toLowerCase();
    17	    if (!email) throw new Error('guest email is required');

=== src/visitors/guest-states.mjs
     1	const RULES = Object.freeze([
     2	    {action: 'checkIn', from: ['registered'], to: 'checkedIn', stamp: 'checkedInAt'},
     3	    {action: 'miss', from: ['registered'], to: 'noShow', stamp: 'missedAt'},
     4	    {action: 'cancel', from: ['canceled'], to: null},
     5	    {action: 'cancel', from: ['registered'], to: 'canceled', stamp: 'canceledAt'},
     6	]);
     7	
     8	export const moveGuest = (guest, action, at) => {
     9	    const rule = RULES.find((candidate) => candidate.action === action && candidate.from.includes(guest.state));
    10	    if (rule === undefined) throw new Error(`cannot ${action} a ${guest.state} guest`);
    11	    if (rule.to === null) return guest;
    12	    return {...guest, state: rule.to, [rule.stamp]: at};
    13	};
=== src/visitors/lobby-policy.mjs
     1	import {nameKey} from './guest-fields.mjs';
     2	import {LOBBY} from '../platform/site-settings.mjs';
     3	import {addMinutes} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     4	
     5	const checkInOpens = (guest) => addMinutes(guest.expectedAt, -LOBBY.earlyArrivalMinutes);
     6	
     7	export const isListed = (guest) => guest.state !== 'canceled';
     8	
     9	export const listedGuests = (guests) => guests.filter(isListed);
    10	
    11	export const guestLimit = (reservation) => reservation.partySize - LOBBY.hostSeats;
    12	
    13	export const hasSeat = (guests, reservation) => listedGuests(guests).length < guestLimit(reservation);
    14	
    15	export const isDuplicateName = (guests, name) => listedGuests(guests).some((guest) => nameKey(guest.name) === nameKey(name));
    16	
    17	export const expectedDuring = (reservation, expectedAt) => reservation.startAt <= expectedAt && expectedAt < reservation.endAt;
    18	
    19	export const isRegistrationOpen = (reservation, at) => at < reservation.endAt;
    20	
    21	const checkInCloses = (guest) => guest.expectedAt + LOBBY.lateArrival;
    22	
    23	export const checkInWindow = (guest) => ({startAt: checkInOpens(guest), endAt: checkInCloses(guest)});
    24	
    25	export const isInCheckInWindow = (guest, at) => {
    26	    const window = checkInWindow(guest);
    27	    return window.startAt <= at && at < window.endAt;
    28	};
    29	
    30	export const hasMissedWindow = (guest, at) => guest.state === 'registered' && at >= checkInCloses(guest);
    31	
    32	const byName = (left, right) => {
    33	    const a = nameKey(left.name);
    34	    const b = nameKey(right.name);
    35	    return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
    36	};
    37	
    38	export const orderGuests = (guests) => [...guests].sort((left, right) => left.expectedAt - right.expectedAt || byName(left, right));

     1	import {normalizeBuildingId, prepareGuest} from './guest-fields.mjs';
     2	import {moveGuest} from './guest-states.mjs';
     3	import {
     4	    checkInWindow, expectedDuring, hasMissedWindow, hasSeat, isDuplicateName, isInCheckInWindow, isRegistrationOpen,
     5	    listedGuests, orderGuests,
     6	} from './lobby-policy.mjs';

     8	const invitationNotice = (guest) => {
     9	    const window = checkInWindow(guest);
    10	    return Object.freeze({
    11	        guestId: guest.id,
    12	        name: guest.name,
    13	        email: guest.email,
    14	        expectedAt: guest.expectedAt,
    15	        checkInFrom: window.startAt,
    16	        checkInUntil: window.endAt,
    17	    });
    18	};
    19	
    20	const arrivalNotice = (guest) => Object.freeze({
    21	    guestId: guest.id,
    22	    reservationId: guest.reservationId,
    23	    name: guest.name,
    24	    checkedInAt: guest.checkedInAt,
    25	});
    26	
    27	const saveThenSend = async (store, send, guest) => {
    28	    const saved = await store.save(guest);
    29	    await send(saved);
    30	    return saved;
    31	};
    32	
    33	export const registerGuest = async ({nextId, notifier, now, request, reservation, store}) => {
    34	    const prepared = prepareGuest(request);
    35	    if (reservation.state !== 'confirmed') throw new Error('guests need a confirmed reservation');
    36	    if (prepared.hostId !== reservation.memberId) throw new Error('only the reservation member can register guests');
    37	    if (!expectedDuring(reservation, prepared.expectedAt)) throw new Error('expected arrival is outside the reservation');
    38	    const at = now();
    39	    if (!isRegistrationOpen(reservation, at)) throw new Error('reservation has ended');
    40	    const guests = await store.listByReservation(reservation.id);
    41	    if (!hasSeat(guests, reservation)) throw new Error('guest list is full');
    42	    if (isDuplicateName(guests, prepared.name)) throw new Error('guest is already registered');
    43	    const guest = {
    44	        id: nextId(),
    45	        reservationId: reservation.id,
    46	        roomId: reservation.roomId,
    47	        buildingId: reservation.buildingId,
    48	        memberId: reservation.memberId,
    49	        name: prepared.name,
    50	        email: prepared.email,
    51	        expectedAt: prepared.expectedAt,
    52	        state: 'registered',
    53	        registeredAt: at,
    54	    };
    55	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.invited(invitationNotice(saved)), guest);
    56	};
    57	
    58	export const findGuest = async ({id, store}) => {
    59	    const guest = await store.find(id);
    60	    if (guest === null) throw new Error('guest not found');
    61	    return guest;
    62	};
    63	
    64	export const checkInGuest = async ({guest, notifier, now, store}) => {
    65	    const at = now();
    66	    if (guest.state === 'registered' && !isInCheckInWindow(guest, at)) throw new Error('outside the check-in window');
    67	    const arrived = moveGuest(guest, 'checkIn', at);
    68	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.arrived(arrivalNotice(saved)), arrived);
    69	};
    70	
    71	export const cancelGuest = async ({guest, now, store}) => {
    72	    const canceled = moveGuest(guest, 'cancel', now());
    73	    if (canceled === guest) return guest;
    74	    await store.save(canceled);
    75	    return canceled;
    76	};
    77	
    78	export const recordNoShows = async ({now, reservationId, store}) => {
    79	    const at = now();
    80	    const missed = (await store.listByReservation(reservationId)).filter((guest) => hasMissedWindow(guest, at));
    81	    const recorded = [];
    82	    for (const guest of orderGuests(missed)) recorded.push(await store.save(moveGuest(guest, 'miss', at)));
    83	    return recorded;
    84	};
    85	
    86	export const listGuests = async ({reservationId, store}) => orderGuests(listedGuests(await store.listByReservation(reservationId)));
    87	
    88	export const changeArrival = async ({expectedAt, guest, notifier, now, reservation, store}) => {
    89	    if (guest.state !== 'registered') throw new Error(`cannot move the arrival of a ${guest.state} guest`);
    90	    if (guest.reservationId !== reservation.id) throw new Error('guest belongs to another reservation');
    91	    if (!expectedDuring(reservation, expectedAt)) throw new Error('expected arrival is outside the reservation');
    92	    if (!isRegistrationOpen(reservation, now())) throw new Error('reservation has ended');
    93	    const moved = {...guest, expectedAt};
    94	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.invited(invitationNotice(saved)), moved);
    95	};
    96	
    97	export const lobbyArrivals = async ({buildingId, from, store, until}) => {
    98	    const building = normalizeBuildingId(buildingId);
    99	    if (!building) throw new Error('building is required');
   100	    if (!(until > from)) throw new Error('arrival range is invalid');
   101	    const guests = await store.listByBuilding(building);
   102	    const expected = guests.filter((guest) => guest.state === 'registered' && from <= guest.expectedAt && guest.expectedAt < until);
   103	    return orderGuests(expected);
   104	};
=== src/visitors/visitor-store.mjs
     1	export const createVisitorStore = (initialGuests = []) => {
     2	    const records = new Map(initialGuests.map((guest) => [guest.id, guest]));
     3	    let writes = Promise.resolve();
     4	
     5	    return Object.freeze({
     6	        find: async (id) => records.get(id) ?? null,
     7	        listByBuilding: async (buildingId) => [...records.values()].filter((guest) => guest.buildingId === buildingId),
     8	        listByReservation: async (reservationId) => [...records.values()].filter((guest) => guest.reservationId === reservationId),
     9	        save: (guest) => {
    10	            writes = writes.then(() => {
    11	                records.set(guest.id, guest);
    12	                return guest;
    13	            });
    14	            return writes;
    15	        },
    16	    });
    17	};
=== src/waitlist/entry-fields.mjs
     1	const trimmed = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '');
     2	
     3	const isPositiveInteger = (value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0;
     4	
     5	export const normalizeRequestKey = (key) => trimmed(key).toLowerCase();
     6	
     7	export const requireRoomId = (roomId) => {
     8	    const value = trimmed(roomId);
     9	    if (!value) throw new Error('room is required');
    10	    return value;
    11	};
    12	
    13	export const requireMemberId = (memberId) => {
    14	    const value = trimmed(memberId);
    15	    if (!value) throw new Error('member is required');
    16	    return value;
    17	};
    18	
    19	const requireWindow = (window) => {
    20	    if (!(window.endAt > window.startAt)) throw new Error('waitlist window is invalid');
    21	    return {startAt: window.startAt, endAt: window.endAt};
    22	};
    23	
    24	export const prepareEntry = (request) => {
    25	    const memberId = requireMemberId(request.memberId);
    26	    const roomId = requireRoomId(request.roomId);
    27	    if (!isPositiveInteger(request.partySize)) throw new Error('party size is invalid');
    28	    const requestKey = normalizeRequestKey(request.requestKey);
    29	    if (!requestKey) throw new Error('request key is required');
    30	    return {memberId, roomId, partySize: request.partySize, ...requireWindow(request), requestKey};
    31	};
    32	
    33	export const prepareOpening = (opening) => {
    34	    const roomId = requireRoomId(opening.roomId);
    35	    if (!isPositiveInteger(opening.capacity)) throw new Error('room capacity is invalid');
    36	    return {roomId, capacity: opening.capacity, ...requireWindow(opening)};
    37	};
=== src/waitlist/entry-states.mjs
     1	import {minutes} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     2	import {OFFER_MINUTES, WITHDRAW_CUTOFF_MINUTES} from './queue.mjs';
     3	
     4	const RULES = Object.freeze([
     5	    {action: 'offer', from: ['waiting'], to: 'offered', stamp: 'offeredAt'},
     6	    {action: 'lapse', from: ['offered'], to: 'lapsed', stamp: 'lapsedAt'},
     7	    {action: 'accept', from: ['offered'], to: 'accepted', stamp: 'acceptedAt'},
     8	    {action: 'withdraw', from: ['withdrawn'], to: null},
     9	    {action: 'withdraw', from: ['waiting', 'offered'], to: 'withdrawn', stamp: 'withdrawnAt', cutoff: WITHDRAW_CUTOFF_MINUTES},
    10	]);
    11	
    12	export const newEntry = ({at, id, prepared}) => ({
    13	    id,
    14	    ...prepared,
    15	    state: 'waiting',
    16	    requestedAt: at,
    17	});
    18	
    19	export const moveEntry = (entry, action, at) => {
    20	    const rule = RULES.find((candidate) => candidate.action === action && candidate.from.includes(entry.state));
    21	    if (rule === undefined) throw new Error(`cannot ${action} a ${entry.state} entry`);
    22	    if (rule.cutoff !== undefined && entry.startAt - at < minutes(rule.cutoff)) throw new Error(`too late to ${action}`);
    23	    if (rule.to === null) return entry;
    24	    const next = {...entry, state: rule.to, [rule.stamp]: at};
    25	    if (action === 'offer') next.expiresAt = at + minutes(OFFER_MINUTES);
    26	    return next;
    27	};
=== src/waitlist/queue.mjs
     1	import {overlaps} from '../platform/periods.mjs';
     2	
     3	export const OFFER_MINUTES = 15;
     4	
     5	export const WITHDRAW_CUTOFF_MINUTES = 60;
     6	
     7	export const MAX_ACTIVE_ENTRIES = 3;
     8	
     9	export const isExpired = (entry, at) => at >= entry.expiresAt;
    10	
    11	export const isLiveOffer = (entry, at) => entry.state === 'offered' && !isExpired(entry, at);
    12	
    13	export const isLapsing = (entry, at) => entry.state === 'offered' && isExpired(entry, at);
    14	
    15	const byId = (left, right) => (left.id < right.id ? -1 : left.id > right.id ? 1 : 0);
    16	
    17	const byRequest = (left, right) => left.requestedAt - right.requestedAt || byId(left, right);
    18	
    19	const matchesOpening = (entry, opening) => entry.roomId === opening.roomId && overlaps(entry, opening);
    20	
    21	export const waitingFor = (entries, opening) => entries
    22	    .filter((entry) => entry.state === 'waiting' && matchesOpening(entry, opening))
    23	    .sort(byRequest);
    24	
    25	export const hasLiveOffer = (entries, opening, at) => entries.some((entry) => (
    26	    isLiveOffer(entry, at) && matchesOpening(entry, opening)
    27	));
    28	
    29	export const nextCandidate = (entries, opening) => (
    30	    waitingFor(entries, opening).find((entry) => entry.partySize <= opening.capacity) ?? null
    31	);
    32	
    33	export const queuePosition = (entries, entry) => {
    34	    const ahead = entries.filter((other) => (
    35	        other.state === 'waiting' && matchesOpening(other, entry) && byRequest(other, entry) < 0
    36	    ));
    37	    return ahead.length + 1;
    38	};
    39	
    40	export const isActive = (entry, at) => entry.state === 'waiting' || isLiveOffer(entry, at);
    41	
    42	export const withinMemberLimit = (entries, memberId, at) => (
    43	    entries.filter((entry) => entry.memberId === memberId && isActive(entry, at)).length < MAX_ACTIVE_ENTRIES
    44	);
    45	
    46	export const orderByRequest = (entries) => [...entries].sort(byRequest);
=== src/waitlist/waitlist-service.mjs
     1	import {prepareEntry, prepareOpening, requireMemberId, requireRoomId} from './entry-fields.mjs';
     2	import {moveEntry, newEntry} from './entry-states.mjs';
     3	import {
     4	    hasLiveOffer, isActive, isLapsing, nextCandidate, orderByRequest, queuePosition, withinMemberLimit,
     5	} from './queue.mjs';
     6	
     7	const lapseNotice = (entry) => Object.freeze({entryId: entry.id, memberId: entry.memberId, lapsedAt: entry.lapsedAt});
     8	
     9	const offerNotice = (entry) => Object.freeze({
    10	    entryId: entry.id,
    11	    memberId: entry.memberId,
    12	    roomId: entry.roomId,
    13	    startAt: entry.startAt,
    14	    endAt: entry.endAt,
    15	    expiresAt: entry.expiresAt,
    16	});
    17	
    18	export const joinWaitlist = async ({nextId, now, request, store}) => {
    19	    const prepared = prepareEntry(request);
    20	    const at = now();
    21	    if (prepared.startAt < at) throw new Error('waitlist window has started');
    22	    const existing = await store.findByRequestKey(prepared.requestKey);
    23	    if (existing !== null) return existing;
    24	    const memberEntries = await store.list({memberId: prepared.memberId});
    25	    if (!withinMemberLimit(memberEntries, prepared.memberId, at)) throw new Error('member has too many waitlist entries');
    26	    const entry = newEntry({at, id: nextId(), prepared});
    27	    await store.save(entry);
    28	    return entry;
    29	};
    30	
    31	const lapseExpired = async (store, notifier, entries, at) => {
    32	    const current = [];
    33	    for (const entry of entries) {
    34	        if (isLapsing(entry, at)) {
    35	            const lapsed = await store.save(moveEntry(entry, 'lapse', at));
    36	            await notifier.lapsed(lapseNotice(lapsed));
    37	            current.push(lapsed);
    38	        } else {
    39	            current.push(entry);
    40	        }
    41	    }
    42	    return current;
    43	};
    44	
    45	export const offerOpening = async ({notifier, now, opening, store}) => {
    46	    const prepared = prepareOpening(opening);
    47	    const at = now();
    48	    const entries = await lapseExpired(store, notifier, await store.list({roomId: prepared.roomId}), at);
    49	    if (hasLiveOffer(entries, prepared, at)) return null;
    50	    const candidate = nextCandidate(entries, prepared);
    51	    if (candidate === null) return null;
    52	    const offered = moveEntry(candidate, 'offer', at);
    53	    await store.save(offered);
    54	    await notifier.offered(offerNotice(offered));
    55	    return offered;
    56	};
    57	
    58	export const acceptOffer = async ({entry, now, store}) => {
    59	    const at = now();
    60	    const next = moveEntry(entry, 'accept', at);
    61	    if (isLapsing(next, at)) throw new Error('offer has expired');
    62	    await store.save(next);
    63	    return next;
    64	};
    65	
    66	export const withdrawEntry = async ({entry, now, store}) => {
    67	    const withdrawn = moveEntry(entry, 'withdraw', now());
    68	    if (withdrawn === entry) return entry;
    69	    await store.save(withdrawn);
    70	    return withdrawn;
    71	};
    72	
    73	export const entryPosition = async ({entry, store}) => {
    74	    if (entry.state !== 'waiting') return null;
    75	    return queuePosition(await store.list({roomId: entry.roomId}), entry);
    76	};
    77	
    78	export const listMemberEntries = async ({memberId, now, store}) => {
    79	    const at = now();
    80	    return orderByRequest(await store.list({memberId: requireMemberId(memberId)}))
    81	        .filter((entry) => isActive(entry, at));
    82	};
    83	
    84	export const listRoomQueue = async ({roomId, store}) => orderByRequest(await store.list({roomId: requireRoomId(roomId)}))
    85	    .filter((entry) => entry.state === 'waiting');
=== src/waitlist/waitlist-store.mjs
     1	export const createWaitlistStore = (initialEntries = []) => {
     2	    const records = new Map(initialEntries.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry]));
     3	    let writes = Promise.resolve();
     4	
     5	    return Object.freeze({
     6	        findByRequestKey: async (requestKey) => (
     7	            [...records.values()].find((entry) => entry.requestKey === requestKey) ?? null
     8	        ),
     9	        list: async ({memberId, roomId} = {}) => [...records.values()].filter((entry) => (
    10	            (roomId === undefined || entry.roomId === roomId) && (memberId === undefined || entry.memberId === memberId)
    11	        )),
    12	        save: (entry) => {
    13	            writes = writes.then(() => {
    14	                records.set(entry.id, entry);
    15	                return entry;
    16	            });
    17	            return writes;
    18	        },
    19	    });
    20	};

=== src/payments/payment-policy.mjs
     1	import {lateFee} from '../platform/invoice-terms.mjs';
     2	import {PAYMENT_TERMS} from '../platform/site-settings.mjs';
     3	import {addMinutes} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     4	
     5	export const isExpired = (intent, at) => at >= intent.expiresAt;
     6	
     7	export const blocksNewIntent = (intent, at) => (
     8	    intent.state === 'captured'
     9	    || intent.state === 'refunded'
    10	    || (intent.state === 'authorized' && !isExpired(intent, at))
    11	);
    12	
    13	export const newIntent = ({at, id, prepared}) => {
    14	    const fee = lateFee(prepared.total, prepared.issuedAt, at);
    15	    return {
    16	        id,
    17	        invoiceId: prepared.invoiceId,
    18	        memberId: prepared.memberId,
    19	        requestKey: prepared.requestKey,
    20	        total: prepared.total,
    21	        fee,
    22	        amount: prepared.total + fee,
    23	        state: 'authorized',
    24	        authorizedAt: at,
    25	        expiresAt: addMinutes(at, PAYMENT_TERMS.authorizationHold),
    26	        captured: 0,
    27	        refunded: 0,
    28	        lastRefund: null,
    29	    };
    30	};
    31	
    32	export const capture = (intent, at) => {
    33	    if (intent.state !== 'authorized') throw new Error(`cannot capture a ${intent.state} payment`);
    34	    if (isExpired(intent, at)) throw new Error('authorization has expired');
    35	    return {...intent, state: 'captured', capturedAt: at, captured: intent.amount};
    36	};
    37	
    38	export const refund = (intent, {amount, reason}, at) => {
    39	    if (intent.state !== 'captured') throw new Error(`cannot refund a ${intent.state} payment`);
    40	    const refunded = intent.refunded + amount;
    41	    if (refunded > intent.captured) throw new Error('refund exceeds the captured amount');
    42	    const next = {...intent, refunded, lastRefund: {amount, reason, at}};
    43	    if (refunded < intent.captured) return next;
    44	    return {...next, state: 'refunded'};
    45	};
    46	
    47	export const voidAuthorization = (intent, at) => {
    48	    if (intent.state === 'voided') return intent;
    49	    if (intent.state !== 'authorized') throw new Error(`cannot void a ${intent.state} payment`);
    50	    return {...intent, state: 'voided', voidedAt: at};
    51	};
    52	
    53	export const netPaid = (intents, invoiceId) => intents
    54	    .filter((intent) => intent.invoiceId === invoiceId && (intent.state === 'captured' || intent.state === 'refunded'))
    55	    .reduce((total, intent) => total + intent.captured - intent.refunded, 0);
    56	
    57	const byAuthorization = (left, right) => (
    58	    left.authorizedAt - right.authorizedAt || (left.id < right.id ? -1 : left.id > right.id ? 1 : 0)
    59	);
    60	
    61	export const orderIntents = (intents) => [...intents].sort(byAuthorization);
=== src/payments/payment-request.mjs
     1	const trimmed = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '');
     2	
     3	const isPositiveInteger = (value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0;
     4	
     5	export const normalizeKey = (key) => trimmed(key).toLowerCase();
     6	
     7	export const requirePositiveAmount = (amount, label) => {
     8	    if (!isPositiveInteger(amount)) throw new Error(`${label} is invalid`);
     9	    return amount;
    10	};
    11	
    12	export const requireInvoiceId = (invoiceId) => {
    13	    const value = trimmed(invoiceId);
    14	    if (!value) throw new Error('invoice is required');
    15	    return value;
    16	};
    17	
    18	export const prepareRefund = (request) => {
    19	    const reason = trimmed(request.reason);
    20	    if (!reason) throw new Error('refund reason is required');
    21	    return {amount: requirePositiveAmount(request.amount, 'refund amount'), reason};
    22	};
    23	
    24	const prepareInvoice = (invoice) => {
    25	    const id = requireInvoiceId(invoice.id);
    26	    const memberId = trimmed(invoice.memberId);
    27	    if (!memberId) throw new Error('member is required');
    28	    if (!Number.isInteger(invoice.issuedAt)) throw new Error('invoice issue time is invalid');
    29	    return {...invoice, id, memberId, total: requirePositiveAmount(invoice.total, 'invoice total')};
    30	};
    31	
    32	export const prepareIntentRequest = (request) => {
    33	    const requestKey = normalizeKey(request.idempotencyKey);
    34	    if (!requestKey) throw new Error('idempotency key is required');
    35	    return {requestKey, invoice: prepareInvoice(request.invoice)};
    36	};
=== src/payments/payment-service.mjs
     1	import {dueAt, isLate} from '../platform/invoice-terms.mjs';
     2	import {
     3	    blocksNewIntent, capture, netPaid, newIntent, orderIntents, refund, voidAuthorization,
     4	} from './payment-policy.mjs';
     5	import {authorizationNotice, receiptNotice, refundNotice, saveThenSend, voidNotice} from './payment-notices.mjs';
     6	import {prepareIntentRequest, prepareRefund, requireInvoiceId} from './payment-request.mjs';
     7	
     8	const intentRequest = ({requestKey, invoice: {id, memberId, total}}) => (
     9	    {requestKey, invoiceId: id, memberId, total}
    10	);
    11	
    12	export const createPaymentIntent = async ({nextId, notifier, now, request, store}) => {
    13	    const prepared = intentRequest(prepareIntentRequest(request));
    14	    const existing = await store.findByRequestKey(prepared.requestKey);
    15	    if (existing !== null) return existing;
    16	    const at = now();
    17	    const intents = await store.listByInvoice(prepared.invoiceId);
    18	    if (intents.some((intent) => blocksNewIntent(intent, at))) throw new Error('invoice already has an active payment');
    19	    const intent = newIntent({at, id: nextId(), prepared});
    20	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.authorized(authorizationNotice(saved)), intent);
    21	};
    22	
    23	export const findPayment = async ({id, store}) => {
    24	    const intent = await store.find(id);
    25	    if (intent === null) throw new Error('payment not found');
    26	    return intent;
    27	};
    28	
    29	export const capturePayment = async ({intent, notifier, now, store}) => {
    30	    const captured = capture(intent, now());
    31	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.receipt(receiptNotice(saved)), captured);
    32	};
    33	
    34	export const refundPayment = async ({intent, notifier, now, request, store}) => {
    35	    const refunded = refund(intent, prepareRefund(request), now());
    36	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.refunded(refundNotice(saved)), refunded);
    37	};
    38	
    39	export const voidPayment = async ({intent, notifier, now, store}) => {
    40	    const voided = voidAuthorization(intent, now());
    41	    if (voided === intent) return intent;
    42	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.voided(voidNotice(saved)), voided);
    43	};
    44	
    45	export const listPayments = async ({invoiceId, store}) => orderIntents(await store.listByInvoice(requireInvoiceId(invoiceId)));
    46	
    47	export const paymentStatus = async ({invoice, now, store}) => {
    48	    const at = now();
    49	    const current = {...invoice, id: requireInvoiceId(invoice.id)};
    50	    return Object.freeze({
    51	        invoiceId: current.id,
    52	        dueAt: dueAt(current.issuedAt),
    53	        late: isLate(current.issuedAt, at),
    54	        paid: netPaid(await store.list(), current),
    55	    });
    56	};
=== src/payments/payment-store.mjs
     1	export const createPaymentStore = (initialIntents = []) => {
     2	    const records = new Map(initialIntents.map((intent) => [intent.id, intent]));
     3	    let writes = Promise.resolve();
     4	
     5	    return Object.freeze({
     6	        find: async (id) => records.get(id) ?? null,
     7	        findByRequestKey: async (requestKey) => (
     8	            [...records.values()].find((intent) => intent.requestKey === requestKey) ?? null
     9	        ),
    10	        list: async () => [...records.values()],
    11	        listByInvoice: async (invoiceId) => [...records.values()].filter((intent) => intent.invoiceId === invoiceId),
    12	        save: (intent) => {
    13	            writes = writes.then(() => {
    14	                records.set(intent.id, intent);
    15	                return intent;
    16	            });
    17	            return writes;
    18	        },
    19	    });
    20	};
